# GitHub Actions disabled

Disabled on 2026-11-09 at the owner's request while account billing is unresolved.
The repository Actions setting is `enabled=false`. Former workflow files are
retained here with `.disabled` suffixes; there are no active workflow definitions.

Build, test and deployment run locally. See `docs/TESTING.md` and
`docs/INSTALL.md`. No GitHub runner result is claimed by a local check.

Re-enabling Actions requires an explicit owner decision, restoring selected
workflow definitions to `.github/workflows/` and enabling repository Actions.
